en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a multi‑arch stone railway viaduct crossing a river in a mountainous, forested valley. A steam locomotive with carriages is traveling across the bridge. Rolling hills, wooded slopes, and a few buildings are visible in the background. At the top of the card, German text identifies the scene as the Bober viaduct near Hirschberg, with the Sattlerschlucht (Sattler gorge).
